description: Check a saved site for problems before the person shares it. Free and read-only: it changes nothing and uses no credits. Pass the designId. It lists, in plain words, a missing page title or description, images with no alt text, links to pages or sections that do not exist, leftover sample text (lorem ipsum, "your headline here", TODO notes, example.com addresses), contact forms whose messages would go nowhere, and anything iter0 would refuse to put online. Each finding has the page, a short message and a suggested fix, most important first; the result says if the list was cut. It never blocks anything. A finding on a single-page site can be fixed with iter0_edit_site, which quotes its price first.

designId.description: The saved design, from iter0_get_design or iter0_list_my_designs.

name: iter0_check_site

editableInChat.description: True for a single-page site, which iter0_edit_site can change. A site with several pages is edited in iter0.

title: Check my site
